mechanism: Sodium valproate may inhibit UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzymes, potentially increasing rosuvastatin exposure and myopathy risk, while rosuvastatin may displace valproate from protein binding.
action: Monitor for signs of myopathy (muscle pain, weakness); consider lipid panel monitoring and dose adjustment if myopathy symptoms emerge; assess valproate levels if rosuvastatin is initiated.
